comment: Logoi's clock and reset jacks use rack's default Schmitt thresholds of 1V and 0V, not the 2V and 0.1V that Stoicheia, Klasmata and Phoreo use. The division knob maps to 1 or any even number from 2 to 64 through divisionFromParamUser at line 367; the division output is a toggle, so a setting of 2 flips it on alternate clocks, while the setting of 1 is a special case that passes the clock gate straight through. The mode switch is configSwitch(MODE_PARAM, 0, 2, 0, "Mode", {"Count", "Delay", "Off"}), and the maker's own comments at lines 347-348 say Count is the switch down and Delay the switch middle. The panel prints no name beside that switch. The delay clocks are ticked once every 64 samples (updateClocksFrequency, line 233).
